import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Survival rate by sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
survival_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
survival_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 2. Survival rate by class
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
survival_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].mean()
survival_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#95e1d3', '#f38181', '#ffd700'])
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax2.set_xlabel('Class')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Age distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax3.hist(df['age'].dropna(), bins=10, color='#a8dadc', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 4. Fare distribution by class
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
for cls in df['class'].unique():
    subset = df[df['class'] == cls]['fare']
    ax4.hist(subset, alpha=0.6, label=cls, bins=5)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Fare')
ax4.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax4.legend()

# 5. Survival count
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
ax5.pie(survival_counts, labels=['Died', 'Survived'], autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=['#ff6b6b', '#51cf66'], startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Overall Survival Rate', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Embarkation town distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
embark_counts = df['embark_town'].value_counts()
embark_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color='#845ec2')
ax6.set_title('Passengers by Embarkation Town', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. Family size (sibsp + parch)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch']
df['family_size'].value_counts().sort_index().plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, color='#f9ca24')
ax7.set_title('Family Size Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Family Size')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count')

# 8. Survival by sex and class
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
survival_matrix = df.groupby(['sex', 'class'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_matrix.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax8, color=['#95e1d3', '#f38181', '#ffd700'])
ax8.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex and Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax8.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax8.legend(title='Class')
ax8.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

plt.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Overview', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
